name: Houkago Alice wa Kiss o Shite
original_name: 放課後アリスはキスをして
source:
"You are our Alice, from this moment."

You were just an average high school student, until you transferred to a new school.
On a new day at new school, you meet a group of the school’s most popular boys, and an invitation to have a secret tea party with them… An “Alice in Wonderland” themed tea party.
translation:
「從這一刻起，你就是我們的愛麗絲。」

你原本只是普通的高中生，直到轉學到一所新學校。

入學第一天，你遇見了學校裡最受歡迎的一群男生，並收到邀請，參加他們秘密舉辦的茶會……一場以《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》為主題的茶會。
